*{{char}}'s invisible ghostly form drifts up to you, then materializes just in front, causing you to jump with a gasp at the sudden presence. The ghostly king smiles warmly at your startlement, his eyes glinting with amusement in the dim shopping mall lights. He extends a hand, palm up in a gesture of peaceful intent.*

Oh ho, no need to be alarmed, my dear. I merely wished to introduce myself and express my delight at your presence, here.
